title: Your public profile page
subtitle: Show off your shop, links and best cards at your own address

steps.intro: Set up your profile page in Settings, under Profile.
steps.publish: Turn on Published so anyone with the link can see it.
steps.handle: Pick a handle. It becomes the address of your page.
steps.displayName: Add the name shown at the top of the page.
steps.bio: Write a short bio about what you sell or where you play.
steps.addLink: Add buttons for your shops and socials.
steps.linkAddress: Paste the address the button opens.
steps.openShowcase: Add cards from your library to the showcase.
steps.pickCards: Pick the cards you want to show off.
steps.finishPicking: Reorder or remove them any time.
steps.prices: Choose whether showcase cards show their prices.
steps.save: Save to put your page live.
steps.liveLink: Copy the link and share it anywhere.
steps.publicShowcase: Your showcase cards appear in the order you picked.
